verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser has a dedicated CAPTCHA-solving docs page stating it can automatically detect and solve CAPTCHAs when this is enabled at session creation, so it has a clear, documented stance of automatic solving. Stealth mode is documented alongside it as anti-detection support. Missing for 10: documentation of what happens when solving fails (error surfacing versus silent failure), any human-in-the-loop fallback, the list of supported CAPTCHA types, and independent or hands-on corroboration that solving works.
